customManagers.description: Renovate's helm-values manager only reads keys named image; minio.mcImage needs its own rule so its digest is refreshed with the minio image.

packageRules.description: Major version bumps often require code changes — require human review.
Keep Rust crate updates isolated because 0.x minor releases often contain breaking changes. Group all minor updates per crate (don't split by individual version).

rust-cache v2.9.2 cleanup can preserve sherpa's prebuilt directory after removing its static archive, poisoning warm Unit Tests caches. Keep v2.9.1 until the action or sherpa validates the archive before reuse.
evalexpr v13 relicensed from MIT to AGPL-3.0 — pin below v13 until migrated to an MIT alternative.
deadpool-redis re-exports redis types — version mismatch causes trait incompatibility.

earshot 1.2.x is a quantized re-implementation, not a tuning release: RNN weights move f32 -> i16 and the probability scale shifts, so the huddle VAD's calibrated threshold regresses at the shipped operating point (TPR 89.57% -> 88.46%, FPR 1.54% -> 2.79% on a matched 121-clip corpus). Unpin only together with a threshold re-pick against that corpus — see the VAD threshold constants in desktop/src-tauri/src/huddle/stt.rs.

MinIO runs from Chainguard's free latest-dev tags pinned by digest; superseded digests are not retained, so refresh them weekly. A digest bump can carry a new MinIO release with a one-way on-disk migration: never automerge. Digests carry no release timestamp, so the global timestamp-required release-age gate is lifted here.
tiptap 3.23.x breaks editor lifecycle under real relay latency — pin until upstream stabilizes.
